question: Who among the following was appointed as the Chairman of the 22nd law commission in November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __Justice Rituraj Awasthi.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Justice Rituraj Awasthi:-

 
 
• He​ was appointed as the chairperson of the 22nd Law Commission in 2022.
 
• He succeeded Justice BS Chauhan who completed his term in August 2021.
 
• Justice Awasthi was a judge of the Allahabad High Court before his appointment as the chairperson of the Law Commission.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Law Commission of India

 
• Law Commission of India is an executive body established by an order of the Government of India.
 
• The Commission's function is to research and advise the Government of India on legal reform, and is composed of legal experts, and headed by a retired judge.
 
• The commission is established for a fixed tenure and works as an advisory body to the Ministry of Law and Justice.
